notice.title: Suspicious activity reporting timeliness
notice.aiSummary: Firms must file suspicious activity reports within 30 calendar days of detection and report SAR volumes and timeliness to the board at least quarterly. These requirements become effective on January 1, 2027.
notice.aiReason: The notice applies to all firms subject to anti-money laundering obligations, and Brivanta Bank as a retail and small-business bank with deposit accounts, lending, and payment services is subject to AML requirements.

text:
ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING DIRECTORATE FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Final rule: Suspicious activity reporting timeliness
Notice number: RCN-2026-012
Issued by: Anti-Money Laundering Directorate
Published: 2026-10-13
Effective date: 2027-01-01
1. Who this applies to
All firms subject to anti-money laundering obligations.
2. Background
Late reports reduce their value to law enforcement. The Directorate sets a firm deadline and asks boards to oversee reporting.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must file a suspicious activity report within 30 calendar days of first detecting the suspicious activity.
3.2 A firm must report suspicious activity reporting volumes and timeliness to the board at least quarterly.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-01-01.

obligations.controlDesc: Weekly report of investigations approaching the 30-day filing deadline
obligations.reason: Policy POL-AML-02 states "Suspicious activity reports are filed within 30 calendar days of first detection," which exactly matches the obligation's 30 calendar day deadline, and Control CTL-163 monitors "investigations approaching the 30-day filing deadline" to detect potential breaches.

obligations.text: A firm must report suspicious activity reporting volumes and timeliness to the board at least quarterly.
obligations.controlDesc: Quarterly suspicious activity reporting metrics presented to the Board Risk Committee
obligations.reason: Policy POL-AML-02 states "Volumes and timeliness are reported to the Board Risk Committee each quarter" which matches the obligation's requirement to report suspicious activity reporting volumes and timeliness to the board at least quarterly, and Control CTL-164 implements this by presenting quarterly suspicious activity reporting metrics to the Board Risk Committee.
